rationale.campaign_length: 共享序章13个直接任务、形成后49个直接任务，主体延伸到全球寻龙和后期重建。
rationale.colonization: 任务要求探索并取得埃兰提尔等海外据点，全球寻龙让远航与殖民贯穿中后期。
rationale.complexity: 陷阱、宝藏、宗教诸相、殖民、技术官僚、专属发明和灾后恢复需要并行规划。
rationale.dark_story: 受迫害历史、身体改造和大陆灾难相当沉重，但国家也有团结、开放与重建的一面。
rationale.difficulty: 开局容错极低，形成后又有多线要求和龙之咆哮的实质性发展损失。
rationale.diplomacy: 会接触多种族和多条龙，但主要推进方式仍是统一、扩张和国家项目，联盟外交不是主循环。
rationale.early_pressure: 三族都面对科技制度落后与远强于自己的侏儒、人类邻国，失误经常直接导致灭国。
rationale.magic_artifice_intensity: 技术官僚、奇械派系、专属龙之飞升发明、肉体工程与拜龙教机制构成战役核心。
rationale.narrative_density: 从受迫害、统一、复兴、升格、灾难到重建和龙族联合，剧情阶段完整且事件密集。
rationale.tall_play: 陷阱、海岸贸易品、巨龙宝藏、首都、奇械体系与灾后重建要求持续经营核心区。
rationale.trade_economy: 巨龙海岸复兴、陷阱贸易收益和宝藏建设很重要，但经济最终服务于奇械与寻龙。
rationale.warfare: 开局统一三族、对抗尼姆斯科德及人类强邻，后续还有海岸和跨洲征服，但并非纯军事树。

identity.appearance: 由红鳞A26、蓝鳞A27或绿鳞A28统一巨龙海岸后形成

national_ideas.scope_note: 国家传统、七项国家理念与野心；不含可选理念组、种族/政府加成。多套候选与条件分别列示，不视为同时叠加；形成时是否接受新理念由实际事件/决议与玩家选择决定。

description.text: 虽然科彼尔德桑的形成为狗头人带来了统一，但他们内部仍有一些琐碎的争吵。最终，这导致了《科彼尔德桑条约》的诞生，该条约指出「任何狗头人都不能掠夺其他狗头人」，这后来被推及到《科彼尔德桑平等法案》中，宣布所有的狗头人都是平等的，无论其鳞片颜色如何。
description.text_en: While the formation of Kobildzan had brought unification to kobolds, they still had petty squabbles internally. Eventually, this gave cause for the creation of the Treaty of Kobildzan, which indicated 'no kobold was to loot another kobold', which was later extrapolated to Equality Under Kobildzan Act which proclaimed that all kobolds are equal, regardless of scale colour.

description.text: 在揭秘时代，许多狗头人被推回到巨龙高地山脉的最深处。然而，随着他们对地表的新知识和新兴的奇械术领域的发展，狗头人种族发展壮大，并把他们的自然洞穴扩展成他们自己的粗糙模仿的古老地下矮人城市。
description.text_en: By the Age of Unraveling much of koboldkind had been pushed back to the deepest depths of the Dragonheight Mountains. However, with their newfound knowledge of the surface and the burgeoning field of artificery, the kobold race boomed and expanded their natural caverns into their own crude mimicry of the underground dwarven cities of old.

description.text: 在狗头人社会，对龙的崇拜在历史的大部分时间里都是极其松散的，并且没有实际的合法性基础。在科彼尔德桑建立后，对龙的崇拜被国家所控制，这导致了实际宗教文本的创造，以及改革，如有记录的巨龙遗产和重要的巨龙的故事成为公认的文学。
description.text_en: The worship of dragons in kobold society was extremely loose throughout the majority of history and had no actual grounds of legitimacy. After the formation of Kobildzan, the worship of dragons came under control of the state, which led the creation of actual religious texts, and reforms such as documented dragon heritage and the tales of significant dragons becoming established literature.

description.text: 狗头人是一群没有耐心的人——这对于传统战争中的一线步兵来说并不合适。狗头人在数量和武器上看到了机会：大量的狗头人会随意向敌人开火，而更大的群体则会用传统的近战武器包围敌人。
description.text_en: Kobolds are an impatient lot - and that does not bold well with the line infantry of conventional warfare. Kobolds saw the opportunity with numbers and their ingenuity in firearms: masses of kobolds would fire at will against the enemy whilst an even greater horde would swarm the enemy with traditional melee weapons.

name.text: 科彼尔德桑火力与蜂群战术

description.text: 一部分是宗教的什一税，一部分是对国家的贡献。1670年，为了使每个狗头人对拜龙教（后来变成了国家的另一个办事处）的贡献正名地引入了囤积税。
description.text_en: Part religious tithe, part contributions to the state. The Hoard Tax was introduced in 1670 to formalize each kobold's contribution to the Dragon Cult (which had then turned into another office of the country).

description.text: 从历史上看，像尼姆斯科德这样的岛屿上的侏儒民族之所以能存活下来，是因为狗头人讨厌水，而且从来没有正规的海军……直到现在。在垃圾场主人希扎克斯·莱克萨的指挥下，科彼尔德桑在1734年组建了它的第一支海军，这支海军全部由金属垃圾组成。1747年，这支海军环游了整个世界。
description.text_en: Historically the survival of the gnomish peoples on islands like Nimscodd was due to the fact that kobolds loathed water and never had a proper navy... until now. Under the command of junkyard owner Sheezax Lexxa, Kobildzan commissioned its first navy in 1734 which was all made of metal junk. The very same navy ended up circumnavigating the entire world in 1747.

description.text: 侏儒喜欢修补，把每件事都做得很完美。矮人喜欢效率和一台运转良好的机器。狗头人喜欢什么？爆炸——更多爆炸！
description.text_en: The gnomes love to tinker and make everything ingeniously perfect. The dwarves love efficiency and a well-oiled machine. What do kobolds love? Explosions - and lots of them!

description.text:
在龙醒之前，狗头人文明依靠密闭的走廊、熔岩冶金和洞穴中的真菌发展壮大。然而，在地表，狗头人无法依赖任何熟悉的东西。他们必须学会利用地表的食物、金属和战术；他们必须在世界的重压下做到这一点。原红鳞狗头人从周围环境中搜刮一切可以搜刮的东西，通过创新的勇气生存下来。

沿海狗头人始终无法掌握的只有一项技能，那就是造船。这并不是因为没有尝试。尼姆斯科德沉没了他们能找到的所有狗头人木筏和齿轮，使得海军发展几乎不可能。从那时起，红鳞狗头人就开始搜刮所有能找到的沉船残骸，建造一支临时舰队来抵挡潮水。「筏匠」乌霍是狗头人新一轮造船浪潮的领军专家，他曾被巡逻的侏儒击沉十次，但仍能幸存下来建造更多的船只。
description.text_en:
Before the Dragonwake, kobold civilization thrived off of tightly-wound corridors, lava-based metallurgy, and cavern-dwelling fungi. On the surface, however, kobolds could rely on nothing familiar. They had to learn to utilize surface foods, metals, and tactics; and they had to do so all while the weight of the world bore down upon them. The proto-Redscales scavenged everything they could from their surroundings, surviving through innovative grit.

Only one practice constantly eluded the coastal kobolds, shipmaking. This wasn’t for a lack of trying. Nimscodd sank whatever kobold raft and cog they could find, making naval development nigh-impossible. Ever since, the Redscales have scavenged every shipwreck they could find, building a makeshift fleet to hold off the tide. Uho ‘the Raftmaker’ was the leading expert of this new wave of kobold shipbuilding, notoriously having been sunk tenfold by the patrolling gnomes and yet surviving to build more ships.

description.text:
虽然学习地表的生活方式具有挑战性，但狗头人在地表最初几年遇到的最大困难是熟悉的事物变得陌生。长期以来，放牧一直是狗头人文化的主要内容，在狭窄的洞穴中，放牧是一件轻而易举的事。但在地表，管理开阔的田野似乎是一项难以完成的任务。

然而，红鳞狗头人却能利用他们的诱捕技能发挥优势；如果到了收获的季节，牲畜无处可去，它们就可以尽情游荡。他们建立了一个庞大的捕猎系统，现在整个巨龙海岸都能找到这个系统，并不断利用它来控制牲畜的数量。很快，红鳞狗头人的土地就以盛产肉类和羊毛而闻名，因此该部落也以其羊毛用品而闻名，如被褥和其他各种覆盖物，以保持他们的物资干燥和防风。
description.text_en:
While learning the ways of the surface proved challenging, the greatest difficulties the kobolds met in those initial years on the surface was how the familiar became unfamiliar. Herding had long been a staple of kobold culture, an easy task given the cramped nature of the caverns. On the surface, though, managing the open fields seemed an insurmountable task.

The Redscales, however, were able to use their trapping skills to their advantage; the livestock could roam all they wanted if they had nowhere to go when it was time to get harvested. They created an extensive trapping system which can now be found across the Dragon Coast, constantly utilizing it to keep the herds in check. Soon, the lands of the Redscales became known for having plentiful meat and wool, and so the tribe became known for its woolen amenities, such as bedding and other assortment of covers to keep their supplies dry and the wind off of them.

description.text:
在与侏儒的诸多小型战争中，为了争夺巨龙海岸，尤其是龙降的统治权，发生了许多战斗，但港口城市（曾经的「下野地」）贝苏尔萨莱之战却让一群肤色猩红的狗头人战队声名大噪，并因此获得了「红鳞」的称号，它标志着狗头人部落开始形成他们闻名遐迩的形态；狗头人指挥官弗伦·斯卡勒休在他的军队的鳞片上涂上了猩红色的战漆，并嘲笑登陆海岸企图掠夺这座城市的瑞维利亚人。
人类入侵者放松了警惕，认为狗头人怪物没有理性，因为他们的战略选择是在红色中突出重围，这导致他们天真地踏上了战前设置的尖刺陷阱。之后，冲突演变成了一场溃败，侥幸逃回战舰的瑞维利亚人向坎诺的其他人讲述了关于可怕的红鳞狗头人故事。
description.text_en:
Many battles were fought over dominion of the Dragon Coast, and especially over the Dragondowns, during the Little Wars, but the Battle of Besurzalay gave such notoriety to a warband of scarlet-hued kobolds that it earned them the name ‘Redscales’. Besurzalay, a port town that had formerly been known as 'Downfield', marked the point where the Kobold tribes began to take the shape they have become known for; the Kobold commander, Vren Scarlethue, coated his army’s scales with scarlet war-paint and taunted the Reverians that had landed upon the shores to attempt to pillage the town.
The human invaders let their guard down, assuming the monstrous kobolds weren’t capable of rationality, given their strategic choice to stand-out in red, which led them to naively step onto spiked pitfalls that had been set up before the battle. After that, the conflict turned into a rout and the Reverians that managed to flee back into their ships told stories to the rest of Cannor about the fearsome Redscale Kobolds.

description.text:
传说中的红鳞统治者阿卡克斯·索扎克斯流着「红龙」尼姆里斯本人的血，然而他在一开始并没有得到同伴们的尊重。起初，阿卡克斯只是一个贱民，因为他声称龙的狡猾而不是力量使它们变得伟大而被人避而远之。对于以凶猛为傲的部族来说，这就是异端。
然后侏儒发动了攻击。老酋长采取了传统的红鳞战术，结果被打得落花流水。尽管是个炮灰士兵，阿卡克斯还是说服了一些狗头人和他一起逃走。然后，他们欺骗侏儒指挥官，让他们以为另一支狗头人大军即将到来，从而使其撤退。
阿卡克斯被誉为英雄，他被任命为新的酋长，并预示着一个新时代的到来，一个以狡猾胜过传统的时代。
description.text_en:
Said to bear the blood of Nimrith the Red himself, the legendary Redscale ruler Aakax Sozax did not begin with the respect of his fellows. Initially, Aakax was little more than a pariah, shunned for claiming that it was a dragon’s cunning rather than its strength that made them great, heresy for the clan that prided itself on its ferocity.
Then the gnomes attacked. The old chief did traditional Redscale tactics and was obliterated. Despite being a fodder soldier, Aakax convinced some kobolds to break away with him. They then tricked the gnome commander into retreating by making them think that another kobold army was coming in.
Hailed a hero, Aakax was made the new chief, heralding a new era prioritizing cunning over tradition.

description.text: 巨龙海岸的狗头人为自己鳞片的颜色感到自豪，他们认为这是他们龙族血统的标志，因为他们和伟大的龙一样是充满活力的单色生物。三族之间的竞争十分激烈，要想在历史上留下浓墨重彩的一笔，维护三色鳞的伟大传奇，是一项巨大的挑战。
description.text_en: The kobolds of the Dragon Coast take pride in the colours of their scales, seeing it as a mark of their draconic heritage to be such vibrant monochromatic beings like the great wyrms themselves. Competition between the three kinsfolk are fierce, with it being seen as the great challenge to make your mark in history by upholding the greatness of your scale-trivu’s legend.

description.text: 那是一个风雨交加的夜晚，特耶坎飞翔着，闪电在咆哮的风暴中噼啪作响，龙渊被吹开，被其中的元素力量所摧毁。特耶坎从狗头人的形态转变为真正的龙类威严。尽管他的逃避令人愤怒；但知道一条龙曾在他们中间生活，他们，那些一直被困在深渊中的狗头人，这却是一种神圣的体验。
description.text_en: It was a dark and stormy night when Tayekan flew, lightning crackled as the storm howled and the Dragondepths were blown open and blasted by the elements from within. Tayekan had transformed from a kobold guise to true draconic majesty. Yet wrothful as his escape was; it was a numinous experience to know that a dragon had lived among them, they, the kobolds who had been trapped within the depths specifically all this time.

description.text: 狗头人认为，海岸的形状是该地区名称的由来，它证明了狗头人对传说中被坎诺神杀死的巨龙马里亚斯的骸骨和遗骸的所有权。这片土地被视为崇高之地，只有最虔诚的龙族才适合在上面行走，因此，即使在他们一盘散沙的状态下，他们也会顽强地争夺每一块岩石和每一条通道，因为侏儒、掠夺者和更多的人都在觊觎他们的家园。
description.text_en: The shape of the Coast that gives the region its name was something the Kobolds took to be evident proof of their claim to the bones and remains of the great dragon Malliath, said to have been slain by the Cannorian Gods. The land is seen as venerable ground, fit only for the most devoted to the dragons to walk upon and so even in their disorganised state they have fought tenaciously for each rock and pass as Gnomes, Reavers and more besides lay covetous claim upon their home.

description.text:
1400年中期，蓝鳞的布鲁萨基，塔耶卡尔·克罗扎莫收到了红鳞狗头人请求签订共同防御条约的信息。布鲁萨基的回复如下：

「你们向我求助，寻求结盟，这是完全合情合理的。所有人都知道，无论蓝鳞族人受到多少次攻击，我们的地道都不会被攻破。但是，生活在田野和浅丘中的你们却很脆弱；只要一个红鳞陷阱被攻破，你们就无处藏身。因此，你们需要帮助。让更多的人死在你们低劣的防御上。

我们不会结盟。如果侏儒迫使你们寻求帮助，那你们的联盟也不过是个连个洞都挖不好的幼崽而已。也许，等你知道你的爪子是干什么用的，我就把我的部队借给你的部落。」
description.text_en:
In the mid 1400s, Buruzagi Tayekar Crozamor of the Bluescales received a message from the Redscales requesting a treaty of mutual defense. Buruzagi’s response was as follows:

“It makes perfect sense that you would come to me for help, that you would seek an alliance. All know that no matter how many times the Bluescales are attacked, our tunnels shall never be breached. But you, who live in fields and shallow hills, are vulnerable; if a single Red trap is broken, there is nowhere for you to hide. And so, you want help. More bodies to die for your shoddy defenses.

There will be no alliance. If the gnomes, of all groups, cause you to seek aid, then your viraxia is nothing more than a hatchling unable to even dig a simple hole. Maybe, once you’ve learned what your claws are for, I'll lend your tribe mine."

name.text_en: Trust in Traps, Not the Other

description.text:
一天，蓝龙特耶坎遇到了两个狗头人。特耶坎向这两个狗头人打听睡觉的地方。这两个狗头人吓了一跳，说他太大了，任何洞穴都住不下。这是个谎言；这对狗头人找到了这个地区最大的洞穴，但不想与人分享。

特耶坎很沮丧，但并不生气。他要求一张用宝石和黄金铺成的床，因为这是他唯一能睡个好觉的地方。年轻的狗头人又一次撒了谎。尽管他们发现了惊人的财富，但他们说，即使每个狗头人都齐心协力，也只能勉强堆出足够让半个特耶坎睡个安稳觉的东西！

特耶坎察觉到了他们的谎言，转过身对狗头人们说道。「你们撒谎了，」他说。「因此，在这个洞穴里的财富足够让我游泳之前，你们再也见不到我了。」就这样，特耶坎穿过洞穴飞向天空，把狗头人的财宝散落在世界各地。骚动把其他狗头人引到了洞穴，两个狗头人解释了事情的经过。其中一个因为失去了特耶坎而气得满脸通红，变成了红鳞狗头人。另一个则因为他们的行为而感到恶心，脸变成了绿色，变成了绿鳞狗头人。于是搜寻狗头人囤积，把特耶坎带回来的使命便落到了我们蓝鳞族人头上。
description.text_en:
One day, Tayekan met two kobolds. Tayekan asked these kobolds for somewhere to sleep. The pair were shocked, and said he was far too large to fit in any cavern or cave. This, though, was a lie; the pair had found the largest cavern in the area, but didn’t want to share.

Tayekan was annoyed, but not angry. He asked for a bed of gems and gold, for it was the only thing he could sleep on. Again, the young kobolds lied. Despite having found incredible wealth, they said that even if every kobold worked together, they could barely pile enough to give half of Tayekan a comfortable sleep!

Tayekan, sensing their lies, turned to the kobolds. “You lied,” he said. “Thus, until this cavern is full of enough wealth for me to swim in, you will never see me again.” With that, Tayekan flew through the caverns out into the sky, scattering the kobolds’ treasure across the world. The commotion brought the rest of the kobolds to the cavern, and the two kobolds explained what happened. One was so angry at losing Tayekan he had turned red. The other was so sick from their actions, he turned green. And so it fell to us Bluescales to hunt down the kobolds’ hoards, to bring Tayekan back.

description.text:
「坎诺人等待奇迹，用隐晦的半真半假来证明信仰的正确性。侏儒们无视任何神性的证据，编造任何站不住脚的诡辩来作为他们『思想』的证据。但马里亚斯直接向他的孩子们提供。

看看龙火火焰喷射器。马里亚斯将他的火焰捐献给了我们，让普通狗头人也能使用神的喷火技能。这种火红色的菌类生长在龙之海岸绝非巧合——它显然是世界蛇亲自赐予我们的礼物。

凝视着矿工的喜悦。看着自己的孩子们在洞穴中辛勤劳作，马里亚斯心痛不已。他渴望给我们一个喘息的机会。他做到了。一种只吃岩石的真菌。留下形状完美的洞穴供我们使用。菌丝体每周都会创造一个真正的奇迹。

让我们在鳞片孢子面前大饱眼福和口福吧。矿井里最大的危险不是塌方，而是饥饿。因此马里亚斯用一种能在孩子们身上生长的蘑菇来拯救他们。蘑菇导致的瘙痒会提醒他们进食，蘑菇的味道会让他们不再贪吃。」——韦克·青鳞的手稿
description.text_en:
"The Cannorians wait for miracles, using veiled half-truths to justify belief. The gnomes ignore any evidence of divinity, concocting any flimsy sophistry to use as evidence for their 'Thought'. But Malliath provides directly to his children.

Look at the dragonfire flamepuff. Malliath donates his very flames to us, allowing the fire breathing of gods to be utilised by the common kobold. It is no coincidence this firey red fungus grows in the dragon coast- it's clearly a gift from the world serpent himself.

Gaze upon the miner's delight. Malliath's heart aches as he watches his children toil in the caverns. He yearns to give us a respite. And so he does. A fungus that eats only rock, leaving perfectly shaped caverns for our use. A true miracle of mycelium every week.

Feast your eyes and stomachs upon the scalespores. The biggest danger in the mines is not a cave-in, it's starvation. And so Malliath gave salvation unto his children with a mushroom that can grow on their very bodies. Its itch is a reminder to eat, and its taste a tool to ward off gluttony." - Manuscripts of Wrek Cyanscale

description.text:
蓝鳞不是巨龙海岸狗头人的第一个「联盟」或「狗头人议会」：但他们是第一个存活超过一代人的。与其他尝试成立的联盟（如870年的褐鳞或906年的苔鳞）不同，蓝鳞主要是通过外交联盟成立的。

他们花了几个月的时间召开会议，确保在一个狗头人统治所有其他狗头人的同时，每个部落都能保持自治，而且他们的首领可以直接与君主接触。最重要的是，「布鲁萨基」将从蓝鳞部落的其他狗头人中挑选一名继承人，将他们视为自己的孩子。当第一任布鲁萨基去世时，所有人都做好了崩溃的准备......但新的布鲁萨基掌权后，国家得以维持。
description.text_en:
The Bluescales were not the first "Viraxia," or "Hierarchy," of the Dragon Coast kobolds: but they were the first that survived for longer than a generation. Unlike the other attempted Viraxias– like the Maroonscales of 870, or the Mosscales of 906– the Bluescales were primarily formed out of a diplomatic union.

Months were spent in meetings, ensuring that while one kobold would rule over all others, each tribe would retain autonomy, and their leaders would have direct access to the monarch. Most importantly, the 'Buruzagi' would choose an heir from one of the other trivuak of the Bluescales, adopting them as their own child. When the first Buruzagi died, everyone braced for collapse... but the new Buruzagi took power, and the state was maintained.

description.text: 巨龙海岸的狗头人为自己鳞片的颜色感到自豪，他们认为这是他们龙族血统的标志，因为他们和伟大的龙一样是充满活力的单色生物。三族之间的竞争十分激烈，要想在历史上留下浓墨重彩的一笔，维护三色鳞的伟大传奇，是一项巨大的挑战。
description.text_en: The kobolds of the Dragon Coast take pride in the colours of their scales, seeing it as a mark of their draconic heritage to be such vibrant monochromatic beings like the great wyrms themselves. Competition between the three kinsfolk are fierce, with it being seen as the great challenge to make your mark in history by upholding the greatness of your scale-trivu’s legend.

description.text: 那是一个风雨交加的夜晚，特耶坎飞翔着，闪电在咆哮的风暴中噼啪作响，龙渊被吹开，被其中的元素力量所摧毁。特耶坎从狗头人的形态转变为真正的龙类威严。尽管他的逃避令人愤怒；但知道一条龙曾在他们中间生活，他们，那些一直被困在深渊中的狗头人，这却是一种神圣的体验。
description.text_en: It was a dark and stormy night when Tayekan flew, lightning crackled as the storm howled and the Dragondepths were blown open and blasted by the elements from within. Tayekan had transformed from a kobold guise to true draconic majesty. Yet wrothful as his escape was; it was a numinous experience to know that a dragon had lived among them, they, the kobolds who had been trapped within the depths specifically all this time.

description.text: 狗头人认为，海岸的形状是该地区名称的由来，它证明了狗头人对传说中被坎诺神杀死的巨龙马里亚斯的骸骨和遗骸的所有权。这片土地被视为崇高之地，只有最虔诚的龙族才适合在上面行走，因此，即使在他们一盘散沙的状态下，他们也会顽强地争夺每一块岩石和每一条通道，因为侏儒、掠夺者和更多的人都在觊觎他们的家园。
description.text_en: The shape of the Coast that gives the region its name was something the Kobolds took to be evident proof of their claim to the bones and remains of the great dragon Malliath, said to have been slain by the Cannorian Gods. The land is seen as venerable ground, fit only for the most devoted to the dragons to walk upon and so even in their disorganised state they have fought tenaciously for each rock and pass as Gnomes, Reavers and more besides lay covetous claim upon their home.

description.text:
「陆地、天空和海洋。
陆地是马里亚斯特赐予我们的，祂的骨骼支撑着世界。我们是马里亚斯之子，我们必须照顾我们古老的父亲。不要浪费土地上的任何东西，以免祂的恩赐白费。每一块岩石和峭壁，每一个坑洞和洞穴，都是为我们而造的。我们只需要在我们所得到的基础上建造，以保证我们自身的安全。
天空是特耶坎赐予我们的，祂的风暴和愤怒使我们比那些其他鳞片的亲戚们敢于走得更远。我们是特耶坎之子，我们应该珍惜祂的恩赐。尽管祂已经抛弃了我们，但天空依然存在。珍惜转瞬即逝的蓝天，利用风暴对抗我们的敌人。我们只需要理解我们所得到的，以保持我们的自由。
海洋仍然保持着冷漠，是陌生人赐予我们的。我们是那个陌生人之子，我们必须找到祂们。海洋是神秘的，祂的洋流赋予和带走生命。学习祂的方式，祂的潮起潮落，以便祂也能保护我们。我们只需要发现我们所得到的，这样我们就可以开始回报。」

——绿鳞口述传统记录
description.text_en:
“Land, skies, and sea.
The land was given to us by Malliath, whose bones hold up the world. We are Malliath's children, and we must care for our ancient father. Waste nothing of the land, so that his gifts won’t be in vain. Every crag and cliff, every pit and cavern, was made for us. We need only build on what we were given, to keep ourselves safe.
The skies were given to us by Tayekan, whose storm and wrath propelled us farther than our other-scaled kin dared go. We are Tayekan's children, and we should cherish his gift. Though he has abandoned us, the sky remains. Cherish the fleeting blue, and wield the storms against our foes. We need only understand what we were given, to keep ourselves free.
The sea remains aloof, given to us by a stranger. We are that stranger's children, and we must find them. The sea is mysterious, its currents give and take life. Learn its ways, its ebbs and flows, so that it too may shield us. We need only discover what we were given, so that we may begin to give back."

- Transcribed Greenscale Oral Tradition

description.text:
「那时，时间已经过去数小时，我几乎已经放弃呼救。我踩踏着盐水、尿水和汗水的混合物，身处陷阱底部……你不禁会想，这样的荣耀到底值不值得。他们不会为这样死去的人编写歌曲。
我已经扔掉了盾牌、盔甲，任何可能拖累我的东西。我想……我想这就是救了我一命的原因。当我看到那个简易盖子移动，看到那张绿色的小脸探进来时，我以为他们要杀了我。我想他们也是这么想的；他们已经准备好了一支长矛，并指向了我。但是当他们看到我——湿漉漉的，没有盔甲，没有武器——他们停住了。我听到他们用奇怪的嘎嘎声交谈，然后他们放下了一根绳子。
我不知道他们为什么饶了我一命。他们从未说过，我也从未问过。他们用长矛指着我，把我带到了边界，然后……就放我走了。这是一次完全沉默的行军，直到最后一个人说道：
『让我们保持宁静，』他们说。
我想我们也应该这样做。」

——马伦·破碎者的叙述，污秽者五十人佣兵团唯一的幸存者。
description.text_en:
"By that time, hours had passed, and I'd all but given up calling for help. Treading a mix of saltwater, piss, and sweat, at the bottom of a pit trap... You wonder how much glory is really worth. They don't write songs about the ones who die like this.
I'd already tossed my shield, armor, anything that could weigh me down. I think... I think that was what saved me. When I saw the makeshift hatch move, saw that green little face poking in, I thought they were going to kill me. I think they thought so, too; they had a spear ready and pointed. But when they saw me– soggy, unarmored, unarmed– they paused. I heard them speaking their strange squawking language, and then they lowered down a rope.
I don't know why they spared me. They never said, I never asked. They led me at spear point to the border and just... let me go. It was a completely silent march, save for the very end when one of them spoke:
‘Leave us to our quiet,’ they said.
And I think we should."

- Account of Marlen the Broken, sole survivor of the Fouler's Fifty mercenary band.

description.text:
「在撰写这份报告时，我认为我对绿鳞族的描述已经足够充分。然而，我尚未意识到在这个新土地上事情发展的速度有多快。现在，出于良心，我不得不承认我……遗漏了一些细节。
确实，我在绘制我们新家园凯尔马多尔周围地区的地图时，被一个巧妙的陷阱捕获。也确实，我被一个自称为『人语者伊特拉』的狗头人审问，而我没有透露任何我认为可能对我们的人民构成风险的信息。而且我建议尊重他们的边界并让其保持原状的立场依然不变。但当我回想起那次遭遇时，我对一个问题感到不安。
『这个……阿勒勒……阿兰……埃兰提尔，你来自那里吗？那里有……龙吗？』
『我……不知道。我只是在故事中听说过埃兰提尔。也许……如果这里的龙苏醒了，那里的龙可能也苏醒了？』
那时，看到她那双奇怪的爬行动物眼睛中的喜悦让我感到宽慰。那种无辜的兴奋，她很快就与同伴们分享……现在，这却让我感到困扰。我担心我可能释放了什么，重新点燃了他们寻找龙的梦想。」

——奥洛里斯·寻路者的公开信
description.text_en:
"At the time of its writing, I thought my report regarding the Greenscales adequate. I did not yet understand how quickly things move in this new land. Now, conscience compels me to admit that I had... omitted certain details.
It is true, I was captured in a cunning snare trap whilst mapping the territory around our new homeland of Celmaldor. And it is true that I was questioned by a kobold who called herself ‘Itla Humanspeaker,’ and that I revealed nothing I thought might pose a risk to our people. And my recommendation that their borders be respected and left alone stands. Yet as I think back on my encounter, I feel unease in regards to one question.
"Thisss... All... Ale... Aelantir you come from? Were there... dragons there?"
"I... wouldn't know. I've only heard of Aelantir in stories. Perhaps... if the dragons awoke here, maybe some did there too?"
Back then, it brought me relief to see the joy in her strange reptilian eyes. Such an innocent excitement, which she readily shared with her fellows... now, it haunts me. I worry what I may have unleashed, in renewing their dream to find the dragons."

- Open Letter from Oloris Wayfinder

description.text:
「我于1416年花开月8日致信于您。绿鳞的情况持续恶化。
先前观察到的『联盟体系』，即每个部落都会派遣力量来抵御其他部落遭受的非狗头人入侵，现已发展到几乎无法区分各个部落的地步。就像在外界压力下被推挤在一起的变质岩石，再也无法分离。
更糟糕的是，我们收到了来自摩尔线人的消息，说有船只被盗。我无需提醒您，如果狗头人获得了真正可以被称为海军的力量，那么我们祖先一千年的努力都将付诸东流。
我理解侏儒山道战役的重要性，但我敦促侏儒议会重新向这条战线投入兵力。如果我们不尽快采取行动，我们可能再也没有机会了。」

——普德科德要塞指挥官辛达·红发的报告
description.text_en:
"I am writing to you as of the 8th of Bloomsdawn, 1416. The Greenscale situation continues to worsen.
The previously observed ‘coalition system,’ wherein each tribe would commit forces to repel non-kobold invasions against other tribes, has evolved to such a state that individual tribes are nearly impossible to tell apart. Like metamorphic stone being pushed together by outside pressures, until it cannot be broken apart any longer.
Worse, we have received words from Moormen informants of stolen boats. I need not remind you that should the kobolds gain functional navies, a thousand years of our forefathers and foremothers work will have been wasted.
I understand the importance of the Gnomish Pass campaign, but I urge the Hierarchy to recommit forces to this front. If we don't strike soon, we may not get another chance."

- Report of Cinda Firehair, Commander of the Plodcodd Garrison.

player_overview.avoid_if: 如果你不愿重开、不喜欢同时兼顾扩张与建设，或不能接受任务事件主动摧毁多年发展成果，请避开。
player_overview.how_it_plays: 前期用陷阱和山口拖垮强敌，统一红蓝绿三族并形成Z38；中期开发海岸、积累宝藏、建立技术官僚制并殖民远航；后期跨洲寻找巨龙、推进血肉改造，承受龙之咆哮后重建并联合各地龙族。
player_overview.overview: 科彼尔德桑是安本纳尔最完整也最艰难的狗头人长篇战役之一。你从红鳞、蓝鳞或绿鳞开局，在侏儒与人类强邻之间靠山口、堡垒和损耗求生；统一后重建巨龙海岸，发展拜龙教、全球寻龙和技术官僚奇械术，让狗头人接受龙之飞升。中后期的龙之咆哮会真正摧毁大片已开发领土，迫使国家从胜利顶峰重新开始。
player_overview.recommended_for: 适合喜欢极难开局、损耗防守、殖民探索、奇械术、长任务树和强烈剧情转折的玩家。
signature_features: 狗头人陷阱把堡垒、人力、敌军损耗与早期生存绑成独有防守循环。
三色鳞族统一后，以跨洲寻龙、拜龙教诸相和巨龙宝藏推动全球叙事。
专属龙之飞升奇械发明和龙之咆哮灾难，形成从肉体升格到文明重建的完整弧线。
player_overview.tagline: 用陷阱熬过灭国危机，统一三色鳞族，以奇械术成为巨龙，再从自己召来的末日中重建文明。

reasons: 陷阱防守让弱小开局拥有真正独特的生存方法
统一三色鳞族、寻龙和龙之飞升组成辨识度极高的成长线
龙之咆哮会实质改变地图和国家状态，剧情代价不是空话
后期奇械构筑和跨洲目标能支撑完整长战役
warnings: 开局容错极低，可能需要多次重开
扩张、殖民、建设、宗教和奇械多线并行，复杂度很高
中后期灾难会摧毁大量发展度和多年建设成果

positive_indicators: 为受迫害狗头人建立家园
values.rationale: 三色鳞族统一、受迫害者家园、多族群技术官僚和灾后重建构成明显正面证据；肉体改造与龙之咆哮造成的大陆灾难则降低尊严与克制。灾难按意图、可预见性、可避免性、受害者态度和灾后行为评估，不能只按伤亡规模等同于恶意毁灭。
red_flags: 强制或痛苦的身体改造风险
龙之咆哮造成大陆级灾难
